messages:
maria-peopleops: Quick question — finalizing the performance timeline. Do managers get a hard deadline for submitting calibration notes, or is there a 48h grace period? :calendar:
jamal-eng: Are you asking about manager calibration sheets or the final rating uploads to the HR system?
maria-peopleops: Manager calibration sheets (the per-direct-report summary + suggested bands). Uploads to HR still follow the system embargo — those are fixed.
sophie-manager: If there's a grace window it should be documented — we had a case last cycle where a late comp change caused churn. prefer no surprises.
alex-englead: For context, some managers are in different regions; a 24-48h grace window for small legit delays would help avoid escalations. but calibration meetings should not be pushed.
maria-peopleops: Ok — current plan: calibration notes due by Mon 2026-06-15 23:59 PDT. We allow a one-time 48h extension per manager for exceptional cases, but you must request it through the form below before the original deadline. After that HR will triage. :memo:
peoplebot: Reminder: calibration materials template v2 uploaded at https://redwood.internal/sheets/calibration-template-v2 — fill in the "Key evidence" and "Suggested band" columns.
jamal-eng: Link to the extension request form?
maria-peopleops: https://redwood.internal/peopleops/extension-request — short form (manager name, employee, reason, estimated submit time). We will auto-approve for small timezone issues, manual for anything else.
sophie-manager: What's the approved workflow for managers who miss the calibration meeting completely?
maria-peopleops: If you miss the scheduled calib meeting, submit your notes by the deadline (or request extension). We'll assign a secondary reviewer from the calibration panel to pull you in for rapid sync if needed. Repeated misses will flag for follow-up.
alex-englead: Can we get a consolidated timeline snippet for sharing on team channels? managers like tl;dr bullets.
maria-peopleops: Yep. TL;DR paste below (feel free to copy into your team channels):
- Self-assessments due: Fri 2026-06-05 11:59 PT
- Manager reviews completed: Fri 2026-06-12 23:59 PT
- Calibration notes due: Mon 2026-06-15 23:59 PT (one 48h extension allowed via form)
- Final ratings locked to HR: Wed 2026-06-17 23:59 PT
- Appeals window opens: Mon 2026-06-22 (details to follow)
jamal-eng: Nice. Can we add a short sentence about what qualifies for an extension?
maria-peopleops: Good call. I'll add: "extensions granted for timezone conflicts, unexpected personal emergency, or documented scheduling conflict with exec-level interviews. Not for missed planning or procrastination."
sophie-manager: Thanks — can you also drop the calibration rubric link? managers use that during prep.
maria-peopleops: Added in the sheet and pinged the calibration panel. Rubric: https://redwood.internal/docs/calibration-rubric-v1.
peoplebot: @here Manager calibration training session scheduled: Thu 2026-06-10 09:00 PT. Recording will be posted. :bell:
alex-englead: One last ask — can we get a single CSV export of manager notes after calibration finish for our org-level analysis?
maria-peopleops: We'll provide an export within 24h after final ratings lock. If you need earlier data for planning, submit a request to people-analytics.
jamal-eng: Perfect. Thanks all.
sophie-manager: Appreciated. I'll notify my ICs about self-assessment deadline. :thumbsup:
maria-peopleops: Great — reach out if any manager needs help filling the template. Closing thread once calendar updates are posted.
